conventions.data_hygiene: Cases that place orders leave data behind. Cancel pending orders when finished so capacity returns, and use the 2nd/3rd seeded slot for capacity-sensitive cases. conventions.staff_fixture_note: Staff fixtures (deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql, fixtures.json): FX-STAFF-ADMIN (preview-ops-1) holds only staff.grant + audit.read and cannot self-grant. FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B: staff.grant, audit.read, config.read, config.write, security.mfa_policy, security.mfa_reset (no finance or order permissions). FX-STAFF-OPS: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override. FX-STAFF-FINANCE: finance.read, finance.verify, finance.refund_approve, finance.settlement, config.read. FX-STAFF-SUPPORT and FX-MULTIROLE: support.case. A second finance.refund_approve holder (FIN-044) or finance.verify for FX-MULTIROLE (FIN-114) needs a temporary grant by FX-STAFF-ADMIN-B, which requires recent MFA.
conventions.mfa_note: origin/develop's Keycloak realm (infra/identity/matbakhy-realm.json) contains no OTP/acr flow, so every step that requires a recent MFA proof (payment recipient approval, payment decision, handover override, staff grants) returns 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED there.
